## History

Julia Bell attended school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her classmates, welcoming [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) warmly when she returned to her studies following her separation from [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). She later participated in a meeting of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), where the members were alerted to Judson Parker's plan to rent his fence for advertisements.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), +2 more_
